messages.subject: removeShape in leaflet-shiny
parts: leaflet-shiny has recently been updated to add geoJson layers and the removeShape command. I am trying to use removeShape but I am not certain I am doing it correctly. On my map I have a large number of circles. They are all created in a single map$addCircle command, and each has their own layerId which links them to the data. When I use map$removeShape, however, I cannot remove them all at once - rather I have to remove them one at a time e.g. map$removeShape(layerId="A", map$removeShape(layerId="B") etc. I can wrap this in a lapply, but it slows down the app considerably. Is there some way to remove multiple shapes at once, without removing them all through clearShapes ?
